name: reframekit
description: reframekit: one finished video in the shape and within the limits of each place it goes to, with a crop that follows what moves.

plugins.name: reframekit
plugins.description: Makes the 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9 versions of a finished video for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, the feeds, YouTube, X and LinkedIn: a crop per shot that follows what moves, or the whole picture on a blurred copy where the action is too wide, each cut at a shot change to the place's length, kept under its file size limit and set to -14 LUFS, with crop.json and sheet.png to check and move the windows.
